channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Jeff Hornacek | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Jeff Hornacek from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Steve Clifford on Kristaps Porzingis, Jeff Hornacek
item.description:
Steve Clifford on Jeff Hornacek:

“He’s a very good coach. He’s done a good job. You can’t lose (Kristaps) Porzingis and then, to me, start judging the coach.”

Steve Clifford on Kristaps Porzingis, Jeff Hornacek, Mar 20, 2018. Source: Twitter @IanBegley.

item.title: Scott Perry on Jeff Hornacek
item.description:
Scott Perry on Jeff Hornacek’s performance:

“I think Jeff is doing a very solid job for this team, getting an opportunity to add to the culture. He and I communicate on a daily basis. We have a strong relationship. I’m looking forward for him to continue to push these guys in the manner we want them pushed, continue to grow as a defensive team, grow our competitive edge.”

Scott Perry on Jeff Hornacek, Dec 10, 2017. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Jeff Hornacek, Kristaps Porzingis, Frank Ntilikina
item.description:
“I think Phil did some good things here. Drafting [Kristaps] Porzingis and hiring Jeff Hornacek. I think [Frank] Ntilikina looks like a good player. It feels like they’re on a good path right now.”

Steve Kerr on Jeff Hornacek, Kristaps Porzingis, Frank Ntilikina, Nov 22, 2017. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Carmelo Anthony on Jeff Hornacek
item.description:
Ian Begley:Carmelo Anthony on Jeff Hornacek:

“He wants us to run, he wants us to get up & down.”

Carmelo Anthony on Jeff Hornacek, Sep 27, 2016. Source: Twitter @IanBegley.

item.title: Tyson Chandler on Jeff Hornacek
item.description:
Paul Coro:Tyson Chandler:

“My wife came home and talked particularly about Coach (Hornacek) and said how comfortable she was about the decision.”

Tyson Chandler on Jeff Hornacek, Jul 9, 2015. Source: Twitter @paulcoro.

item.title: Gordon Hayward on Jeff Hornacek
item.description:
Aaron Falk:Hayward on Hornacek:

“Definitely miss him. He was my guy here, taught me a lot about basketball.”

Gordon Hayward on Jeff Hornacek, Feb 26, 2014. Source: Twitter @tribjazz.

item.title: Goran Dragic on Jeff Hornacek
item.description:
“We didn't win a lot of games, and most of the guys were not — how you say — happy. You didn't see smiles on our faces. But this year, I think (Hornacek) changed that. Everybody is on the same page, and everybody wants to come to practice.”

Goran Dragic on Jeff Hornacek, Dec 28, 2013. Source: USA Today Sports.

item.title: Tyrone Corbin on Jeff Hornacek
item.description:
Jody Genessy:Tyrone Corbin on Jeff Hornacek's departure:

“On behalf of the Jazz, I want to thank Jeff for his hard work, loyalty and dedication.”

Tyrone Corbin on Jeff Hornacek, May 28, 2013. Source: Twitter @DJJazzyJody.
